verdict.rationale: Glama is an MCP gateway and hosting platform, so a white-labeled authorization flow is a fair question for it. The evidence only shows that gateway calls are 'credential-managed' and that the inspector can test OAuth 2.1. Neither is about custom branding of the auth flow or bringing your own OAuth app credentials, so both count only as adjacent features.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can white-label the authorization flow with my own branding and my own OAuth app credentials
